clos.original_description: Gain a comprehensive understanding of fundamental principles in processing speech signals, covering digital signal processing (DSP) methods, feature extraction, and speech signal analysis
clos.enriched_description: Gain a comprehensive understanding of fundamental principles in processing speech signals, covering digital signal processing (DSP) methods, feature extraction, and speech signal analysis. The scope includes Introduction to Digital Speech Processing; The Speech Signal; The Speech Stack; Discrete-Time Signals and Systems; Transform Representation of Signals and Systems; Fundamentals of Digital Filters; Human Speech Production; The Process of Speech Production; Short-Time Fourier Representation of Speech; Distinctive Features of The Phonemes English; Hearing, Auditory Models, and Speech Perception; and The Speech Chain.

clos.original_description: Develop expertise in speech recognition and synthesis, exploring and applying various algorithms for automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speech synthesis, including rule-based and statistical approaches
clos.enriched_description: Develop expertise in speech recognition and synthesis, exploring and applying various algorithms for automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speech synthesis, including rule-based and statistical approaches. The scope includes Time-Domain Methods for Speech Processing, Short-Time Analysis of Speech, Automatic Speech Recognition and NLU, and Overall Speech Recognition Process.

clos.original_description: Apply relevant machine learning algorithms and models to address speech-processing challenges, including feature extraction, classification, and other tasks within the speech context
clos.enriched_description: Apply relevant machine learning algorithms and models to address speech-processing challenges, including feature extraction, classification, and other tasks within the speech context. The scope includes Linear Predictive Analysis of Speech Signals, Algorithms for Estimating Speech Parameters, Median Smoothing and Speech Processing, and Speech-Background/Slience Discrimination.

clos.original_description: Acquire practical skills by using and implementing widely-used speech-processing tools, software, libraries, and frameworks, such as Praat, HTK, or other relevant platforms
clos.enriched_description: Acquire practical skills by using and implementing widely-used speech-processing tools, software, libraries, and frameworks, such as Praat, HTK, or other relevant platforms. The scope includes Text-to-Speech Synthesis Methods, Text Analysis, Evolution of Speech Synthesis Methods, and Early Speech Synthesis Approaches.

clos.original_description: Demonstrate the ability to assess speech-processing system performance, applying appropriate metrics to evaluate accuracy and efficiency in speech recognition and synthesis models. Critically analyze the strengths and limitations of various approaches
clos.enriched_description: Demonstrate the ability to assess speech-processing system performance, applying appropriate metrics to evaluate accuracy and efficiency in speech recognition and synthesis models. Critically analyze the strengths and limitations of various approaches. The scope includes Automatic Speech Recognition and NLU and Overall Speech Recognition Process.
